# Pleat

> Pleat is an iPhone app for people who sew. It keeps a fabric stash with lengths, checks the stash before you buy, plans projects against it, and adds up what a make really cost (fabric by the length used, notions, the pattern and logged hours). In beta; free during the beta. Made by one developer, Ekaterina Baliasnikova.

Key facts:
- Platform: iPhone only (iOS 18 or later). No account, no sync: data stays on the device.
- Free plan: up to 30 fabrics, 10 notions, 5 patterns and 3 active projects.
- Pleat+: $19.99/year with a 14-day free trial, $2.99/month, or $49.99 once. Adds unlimited items, line-by-line cost, suggested sale price, Lock Screen timer, stats and CSV export.
- Contact: support@plts.app

Every page is also available as Markdown: request it with `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path.
